name: 3S Auto-Raid (GMCP)
author: Joakim
description: 3Scapes auto-raid: dispatch docked longships to a target town (solo or convoy). Fed by the Guild.Voyage (longships) + Guild.City (heat, dock) + Guild.Kingdom (home towns) GMCP packages, with the foreign town list read off `vlongship targets` ('araid targets' sends it) - Guild.Fleet, which used to carry the ships and both town lists, stopped in September 2026 (3Scapes only; the MIP-fed original was retired in September 2026 when 3Scapes dropped its MIP feed). A Raids tab (2.3.0) reads Guild.Fleet's raidlog: every raid with its ship, town, daler and the goods it brought, a total line, and the log folded by town (best paying first - a click targets it) and by ship. Same strategy core as the classic: auto-target picks randomly among the calm pool (towns within 2 heat of the lowest), hold rotates towns, keep/reserve protect docked ships, convoy sends one command for the game to crew. The town table lists BOTH target groups - home (lineage, with heat) and foreign (historical, no heat in the feed) - every name clickable, and 'araid pool home|foreign' chooses which group the auto-target raids: home hunts the calm pool, foreign spreads at random with the same hold rotation.
